identitySignals: Name matches 'StaffRehab', a company headquartered in Newport Beach, CA, matching the agenda location (press release and business directories)
StaffRehab provides therapy, nursing and behavioral health services to children with special needs in school settings, matching OUSD's Special Education nonpublic agency master contract
research.notes: Official site staffrehab.com now redirects to a domain-for-sale page, so no website is listed. No registry entry (CA Secretary of State, SAM.gov) could be confirmed, and no page found links StaffRehab to OUSD. Newport Beach address (5000 Birch St, Suite 3000) and phone appear only on third-party directories, so were not included. Entity is now a subsidiary of The Stepping Stones Group; legal entity name unverified.

profile.summary: StaffRehab is a company that provides therapy, nursing, and behavioral health services to children with autism and other special needs in school settings. It was founded in 2009 and was acquired in 2019 by The Stepping Stones Group, a national provider of school-based therapy and behavioral health services.

sources.title: The Stepping Stones Group Acquires StaffRehab
